We have illustrated keeping at least 80% of the formatting of tables, images and formulas from the original document. All of our translations are done very carefully. You can compare other translations. You can access the link of the original document in column E in the Report File (after accessing, click “View Full Paper”) and the link of the Vietnamese translation in column I in the Report File. The page number of the translation and the page number of the original document are the same, so the comparison is extremely easy.
This is a qualitative criterion, and the goal of the work is to create a knowledge library for the Vietnam Cardano community. We have tried our best to do our best. We have worked for many hours to keep the formatting of the formulas, tables and images like that. The results of our work are clearly demonstrated through the Vietnamese translations. Furthermore, we have also provided illustrative evidence of preserving at least 80% of the formatting of tables, formulas and images compared to the original document.
